title: 从方案与同意到可解释的数据锁定
scope: Synthetic SYN-T02; 2 sites, 4 fictional participants, 3 forms each. Local strict query→signature→lock policy; no diagnosis, regulatory compliance claim, real participant data or provider integration. CTMS=Veeva CTMS, EDC=Medidata Rave EDC retain source identity; Veeva EDC operational docs are separate supplemental references.
